title: astracantha lateritians
intro: Astracantha lateritians, commonly known as Bitter Vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha lateritians include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
